hero.intro: An Algerian outdoor club. Mountains, Sahara, coast, camping and heritage. We head out together and discover our own country.
about.title: Nature is our therapy
about.p1: Routine wears you down. Work, studies, traffic, the same week on repeat. Fresh Move exists to break that loop: we get a crew together, climb a mountain or head down to the Sahara, and come back with a lighter heart.
about.p2: What you need every weekend: fresh air, a new trail, and people who get you. You don't have to be a pro. You just have to want to move.
pillar.travel.title: Travel
pillar.travel.text: North to south, we discover Algeria one wilaya at a time.
pillar.nature.title: Nature
pillar.nature.text: Forests, rivers, sea and sand. Nature is where we recharge.
pillar.history.title: History
pillar.history.text: Roman ruins, old forts and our country's stories. Every stone has one.
pillar.adventure.title: Adventure
pillar.adventure.text: Summits, camping and nights around the fire. That's the whole move.

how.title: Book in four steps
how.step1.title: Reserve your seat on the site
how.step1.text: Pick a trip and fill in the form. You get a reservation code.
how.step2.title: Pay before your hold expires
how.step2.text: BaridiMob, CCP or cash, as explained on the trip page.
how.step3.title: Send the proof on Instagram
how.step3.text: DM us a photo of the receipt with your code.
how.step4.title: We confirm your seat
how.step4.text: Once we see the payment, the seat is yours. You can check the status on the site.
how.note: Trips are announced on Instagram and booked here on the site. Only pay using the methods listed on the trip page.
faq.title: Questions we get a lot
faq.a1: Anyone aged {minAge} or over who wants to get outdoors, from any wilaya.
faq.a2: No. Some trips are easy and some are tougher. Before you book, ask us in a DM how hard it is.
faq.q3: How do I book a trip?
faq.a3: Pick the trip on the site, fill in the form and you'll get a code. Pay before your hold expires, then DM us the receipt with your code on Instagram.
faq.a4: Yes, joining the club is free. Each trip has its own price, announced on Instagram.
faq.a5: Comfortable shoes, water, light snacks, a jacket, plus whatever each trip announcement lists.
faq.a6: Send us a DM on Instagram at @fresh_move1.

privacy.title: Privacy notice
privacy.intro: A short note on what we do with the information you give us in the membership form.
privacy.what.title: What we collect
privacy.what.text: When you sign up or book: your full name, phone or WhatsApp number, wilaya, age and language. For bookings also: the trip, your reservation code, its status (held, confirmed, waitlist), and the payment method and amount.
privacy.why.title: Why
privacy.why.text: To manage memberships and bookings and to contact you about trips. We never sell it or share it with anyone.
privacy.who.title: Who can see it
privacy.who.text: Only the club admins. The data is stored in a protected database at Supabase (EU), and the site runs on Cloudflare. They process it on our behalf only.
privacy.keep.title: How long we keep it
privacy.keep.text: Membership info: as long as you are a member. Booking details: we remove the link to you {months} months after the trip ends (only counts are kept for statistics).
privacy.delete.title: How to ask for deletion
privacy.delete.text: Send us a DM on Instagram at @fresh_move1 saying "please delete my info". We'll remove it as soon as we can.
privacy.law: This notice follows Algerian Law No. 18-07 on the protection of individuals in the processing of personal data. You have the right to see, correct or delete your information.
privacy.disclaimer: Note: this is a plain-language notice, not legal advice.
